verses.original: Ἀλήθειαν λέγω ἐν Χριστῷ οὐ ψεύδομαι συμμαρτυρούσης μοι τῆς συνειδήσεώς μου ἐν Πνεύματι Ἁγίῳ
verses.transliteration: Alētheian legō en Christō ou pseudomai symmartyrousēs moi tēs syneidēseōs mou en Pneumati Hagiō
verses.literal: I speak the truth in Christ I am not lying as confirmed . . . by my conscience in the Holy Spirit
verses.literalPt: EM Cristo digo a verdade, não minto (dando-me testemunho a minha consciência no Espírito Santo):

verses.original: ὅτι λύπη μοί ἐστιν μεγάλη καὶ ἀδιάλειπτος ὀδύνη τῇ καρδίᾳ μου
verses.transliteration: hoti lypē moi estin megalē kai adialeiptos odynē tē kardia mou
verses.literal: I have deep sorrow and unceasing anguish in my heart
verses.literalPt: Que tenho grande tristeza e contínua dor no meu coração.

verses.original: ηὐχόμην γὰρ ἀνάθεμα εἶναι αὐτὸς ἐγὼ ἀπὸ τοῦ Χριστοῦ ὑπὲρ τῶν ἀδελφῶν μου τῶν συγγενῶν μου κατὰ σάρκα
verses.transliteration: ēuchomēn gar anathema einai autos egō apo tou Christou hyper tōn adelphōn mou tōn syngenōn mou kata sarka
verses.literal: For I could wish that I myself were cursed and cut off from Christ for the sake of my brothers my own flesh and blood . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Porque eu mesmo poderia desejar ser anátema de Cristo, por amor de meus irmãos, que são meus parentes segundo a carne;

verses.original: οἵτινές εἰσιν Ἰσραηλῖται ὧν ἡ υἱοθεσία καὶ ἡ δόξα καὶ αἱ διαθῆκαι καὶ ἡ νομοθεσία καὶ ἡ λατρεία καὶ αἱ ἐπαγγελίαι
verses.transliteration: hoitines eisin Israēlitai hōn hē huiothesia kai hē doxa kai hai diathēkai kai hē nomothesia kai hē latreia kai hai epangeliai
verses.literal: the people of Israel Theirs is the adoption as sons theirs the divine glory and the covenants theirs the giving of the law the temple worship and the promises
verses.literalPt: Que são israelitas, dos quais é a adoção de filhos, e a glória, e as alianças, e a lei, e o culto, e as promessas;

verses.original: ὧν οἱ πατέρες καὶ ἐξ ὧν ὁ Χριστὸς τὸ κατὰ σάρκα ὁ ὢν ἐπὶ πάντων Θεὸς εὐλογητὸς εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: hōn hoi pateres kai ex hōn ho Christos to kata sarka ho ōn epi pantōn Theos eulogētos eis tous aiōnas amēn
verses.literal: Theirs are the patriarchs and from them proceeds the human descent of Christ who is God over all forever worthy of praise Amen
verses.literalPt: Dos quais são os pais, e dos quais é Cristo segundo a carne, o qual é sobre todos, Deus bendito eternamente. Amém.

verses.original: Οὐχ οἷον δὲ ὅτι ἐκπέπτωκεν ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ οὐ γὰρ πάντες οἱ ἐξ Ἰσραήλ οὗτοι Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: Ouch hoion de hoti ekpeptōken ho logos tou Theou ou gar pantes hoi ex Israēl houtoi Israēl
verses.literal: It is not as though - God’s word has failed For not all who are descended from Israel are Israel
verses.literalPt: Não que a palavra de Deus haja faltado, porque nem todos os que são de Israel são israelitas;

verses.original: οὐδ’ ὅτι εἰσὶν σπέρμα Ἀβραάμ πάντες τέκνα ἀλλ’ Ἐν Ἰσαὰκ κληθήσεταί σοι σπέρμα
verses.transliteration: oud’ hoti eisin sperma Abraam pantes tekna all’ En Isaak klēthēsetai soi sperma
verses.literal: Nor because they are Abraham’s descendants are they all his children On the contrary Through Isaac your offspring will be reckoned
verses.literalPt: Nem por serem descendência de Abraão são todos filhos; mas: Em Isaque será chamada a tua descendência.

verses.original: τοῦτ’ ἔστιν οὐ τὰ τέκνα τῆς σαρκὸς ταῦτα τέκνα τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀλλὰ τὰ τέκνα τῆς ἐπαγγελίας λογίζεται εἰς σπέρμα
verses.transliteration: tout’ estin ou ta tekna tēs sarkos tauta tekna tou Theou alla ta tekna tēs epangelias logizetai eis sperma
verses.literal: So it is not the children of the flesh who are God’s children but it is the children of the promise who are regarded as offspring
verses.literalPt: Isto é, não são os filhos da carne que são filhos de Deus, mas os filhos da promessa são contados como descendência.

verses.original: ἐπαγγελίας γὰρ ὁ λόγος οὗτος Κατὰ τὸν καιρὸν τοῦτον ἐλεύσομαι καὶ ἔσται τῇ Σάρρᾳ υἱός
verses.transliteration: epangelias gar ho logos houtos Kata ton kairon touton eleusomai kai estai tē Sarra huios
verses.literal: For this is what the promise stated At the appointed time I will return and Sarah will have a son
verses.literalPt: Porque a palavra da promessa é esta: Por este tempo virei, e Sara terá um filho.

verses.original: Οὐ μόνον δέ ἀλλὰ καὶ Ῥεβέκκα ἐξ ἑνὸς κοίτην ἔχουσα Ἰσαὰκ τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: Ou monon de alla kai Rhebekka ex henos koitēn echousa Isaak tou patros hēmōn
verses.literal: Not only that but Rebecca’s children were conceived by one man our father Isaac
verses.literalPt: E não somente esta, mas também Rebeca, quando concebeu de um, de Isaque, nosso pai;

verses.original: μήπω γὰρ γεννηθέντων μηδὲ πραξάντων τι ἀγαθὸν ἢ φαῦλον ἵνα ἡ κατ’ ἐκλογὴν πρόθεσις τοῦ Θεοῦ μένῃ
verses.transliteration: mēpō gar gennēthentōn mēde praxantōn ti agathon ē phaulon hina hē kat’ eklogēn prothesis tou Theou menē
verses.literal: Yet before the twins were born or had done anything good or bad in order that - God’s plan of election might stand
verses.literalPt: Porque, não tendo eles ainda nascido, nem tendo feito bem ou mal (para que o propósito de Deus, segundo a eleição, ficasse firme, não por causa das obras, mas por aquele que chama),

verses.original: οὐκ ἐξ ἔργων ἀλλ’ ἐκ τοῦ καλοῦντος ἐρρέθη αὐτῇ ὅτι Ὁ μείζων δουλεύσει τῷ ἐλάσσονι
verses.transliteration: ouk ex ergōn all’ ek tou kalountos errethē autē hoti Ho meizōn douleusei tō elassoni
verses.literal: not by works but by Him who calls she was told The older will serve the younger
verses.literalPt: Foi-lhe dito a ela: O maior servirá o menor.

verses.original: καθὼς γέγραπται Τὸν Ἰακὼβ ἠγάπησα τὸν δὲ Ἠσαῦ ἐμίσησα
verses.transliteration: kathōs gegraptai Ton Iakōb ēgapēsa ton de Ēsau emisēsa
verses.literal: So it is written Jacob I loved but Esau I hated
verses.literalPt: Como está escrito: Amei a Jacó, e odiei a Esaú.

verses.original: Τί οὖν ἐροῦμεν μὴ ἀδικία παρὰ τῷ θεῷ μὴ γένοιτο
verses.transliteration: Ti oun eroumen mē adikia para tō theō mē genoito
verses.literal: What then shall we say Is - God unjust Certainly not
verses.literalPt: Que diremos pois? que há injustiça da parte de Deus? De maneira nenhuma.

verses.original: τῷ Μωϋσεῖ γὰρ λέγει Ἐλεήσω ὃν ἂν ἐλεῶ καὶ οἰκτιρήσω ὃν ἂν οἰκτίρω
verses.transliteration: tō Mōusei gar legei Eleēsō hon an eleō kai oiktirēsō hon an oiktirō
verses.literal: For He says to Moses I will have mercy on whom I have mercy and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion
verses.literalPt: Pois diz a Moisés: Compadecer-me-ei de quem me compadecer, e terei misericórdia de quem eu tiver misericórdia.

verses.original: Ἄρα οὖν οὐ τοῦ θέλοντος οὐδὲ τοῦ τρέχοντος ἀλλὰ τοῦ ἐλεῶντος Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ara oun ou tou thelontos oude tou trechontos alla tou eleōntos Theou
verses.literal: So then it does not depend on man’s desire or effort but on God’s mercy
verses.literalPt: Assim, pois, isto não depende do que quer, nem do que corre, mas de Deus, que se compadece.

verses.original: λέγει γὰρ ἡ γραφὴ τῷ Φαραὼ ὅτι Εἰς αὐτὸ τοῦτο ἐξήγειρά σε ὅπως ἐνδείξωμαι ἐν σοὶ τὴν δύναμίν μου καὶ ὅπως διαγγελῇ τὸ ὄνομά μου ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ
verses.transliteration: legei gar hē graphē tō Pharaō hoti Eis auto touto exēgeira se hopōs endeixōmai en soi tēn dynamin mou kai hopōs diangelē to onoma mou en pasē tē gē
verses.literal: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh I raised you up . . . for this very purpose that I might display My power in you and that My name might be proclaimed in all the earth
verses.literalPt: Porque diz a Escritura a Faraó: Para isto mesmo te levantei; para em ti mostrar o meu poder, e para que o meu nome seja anunciado em toda a terra.

verses.original: ἄρα οὖν ὃν θέλει ἐλεεῖ ὃν δὲ θέλει σκληρύνει
verses.transliteration: ara oun hon thelei eleei hon de thelei sklērynei
verses.literal: Therefore . . . God has mercy on whom He wants to have mercy and He hardens whom He wants to harden
verses.literalPt: Logo, pois, compadece-se de quem quer, e endurece a quem quer.

verses.original: Ἐρεῖς μοι οὖν Τί οὖν ἔτι μέμφεται τῷ γὰρ βουλήματι αὐτοῦ τίς ἀνθέστηκεν
verses.transliteration: Ereis moi oun Ti oun eti memphetai tō gar boulēmati autou tis anthestēken
verses.literal: One of you will say to me Then why does God still find fault For who can resist His will
verses.literalPt: Dir-me-ás então: Por que se queixa ele ainda? Porquanto, quem tem resistido à sua vontade?

verses.original: ὦ ἄνθρωπε μενοῦνγε σὺ τίς εἶ ὁ ἀνταποκρινόμενος τῷ Θεῷ μὴ ἐρεῖ τὸ πλάσμα τῷ πλάσαντι Τί με ἐποίησας οὕτως
verses.transliteration: ō anthrōpe menounge sy tis ei ho antapokrinomenos tō Theō mē erei to plasma tō plasanti Ti me epoiēsas houtōs
verses.literal: But who are you O man - to talk back to God Shall what is formed say to Him who formed it Why did You make me like this
verses.literalPt: Mas, ó homem, quem és tu, que a Deus replicas? Porventura a coisa formada dirá ao que a formou: Por que me fizeste assim?

verses.original: ἢ οὐκ ἔχει ἐξουσίαν ὁ κεραμεὺς τοῦ πηλοῦ ἐκ τοῦ αὐτοῦ φυράματος ποιῆσαι ὃ μὲν εἰς τιμὴν σκεῦος ὃ δὲ εἰς ἀτιμίαν
verses.transliteration: ē ouk echei exousian ho kerameus tou pēlou ek tou autou phyramatos poiēsai ho men eis timēn skeuos ho de eis atimian
verses.literal: Does not the potter have the right to make from the same lump of clay one vessel for special occasions and another for common use
verses.literalPt: Ou não tem o oleiro poder sobre o barro, para da mesma massa fazer um vaso para honra e outro para desonra?

verses.original: Εἰ δὲ θέλων ὁ Θεὸς ἐνδείξασθαι τὴν ὀργὴν καὶ γνωρίσαι τὸ δυνατὸν αὐτοῦ ἤνεγκεν ἐν πολλῇ μακροθυμίᾳ σκεύη ὀργῆς κατηρτισμένα εἰς ἀπώλειαν
verses.transliteration: Ei de thelōn ho Theos endeixasthai tēn orgēn kai gnōrisai to dynaton autou ēnenken en pollē makrothymia skeuē orgēs katērtismena eis apōleian
verses.literal: What if God intending to show His wrath and make His power known bore with great patience the vessels of His wrath prepared for destruction
verses.literalPt: E que direis se Deus, querendo mostrar a sua ira, e dar a conhecer o seu poder, suportou com muita paciência os vasos da ira, preparados para a perdição;

verses.original: καὶ ἵνα γνωρίσῃ τὸν πλοῦτον τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ σκεύη ἐλέους ἃ προητοίμασεν εἰς δόξαν
verses.transliteration: kai hina gnōrisē ton plouton tēs doxēs autou epi skeuē eleous ha proētoimasen eis doxan
verses.literal: What if He did this to make the riches of His glory known to the vessels of His mercy whom He prepared in advance for glory
verses.literalPt: Para que também desse a conhecer as riquezas da sua glória nos vasos de misericórdia, que para glória já dantes preparou,

verses.original: οὓς καὶ ἐκάλεσεν ἡμᾶς οὐ μόνον ἐξ Ἰουδαίων ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐξ ἐθνῶν
verses.transliteration: hous kai ekalesen hēmas ou monon ex Ioudaiōn alla kai ex ethnōn
verses.literal: including us whom He has called not only from the Jews but also from the Gentiles
verses.literalPt: Os quais somos nós, a quem também chamou, não só dentre os judeus, mas também dentre os gentios?

verses.original: ὡς καὶ ἐν τῷ Ὡσηὲ λέγει Καλέσω τὸν οὐ λαόν μου λαόν μου καὶ τὴν οὐκ ἠγαπημένην ἠγαπημένην
verses.transliteration: hōs kai en tō Hōsēe legei Kalesō ton ou laon mou laon mou kai tēn ouk ēgapēmenēn ēgapēmenēn
verses.literal: As He says in Hosea I will call them My People who are not My people and I will call her My Beloved who is not My beloved
verses.literalPt: Como também diz em Oséias: Chamarei meu povo ao que não era meu povo; E amada à que não era amada.

verses.original: Καὶ Ἔσται ἐν τῷ τόπῳ οὗ ἐρρέθη αὐτοῖς Οὐ λαός μου ὑμεῖς ἐκεῖ κληθήσονται Υἱοὶ Θεοῦ ζῶντος
verses.transliteration: Kai Estai en tō topō hou errethē autois Ou laos mou hymeis ekei klēthēsontai Huioi Theou zōntos
verses.literal: and It will happen that in the very place where it was said to them You are not My people they will be called sons of the living God
verses.literalPt: E sucederá que no lugar em que lhes foi dito: Vós não sois meu povo; Aí serão chamados filhos do Deus vivo.

verses.original: Ἠσαΐας δὲ κράζει ὑπὲρ τοῦ Ἰσραήλ Ἐὰν ᾖ ὁ ἀριθμὸς τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ ὡς ἡ ἄμμος τῆς θαλάσσης τὸ ὑπόλειμμα σωθήσεται
verses.transliteration: Ēsaias de krazei hyper tou Israēl Ean ē ho arithmos tōn huiōn Israēl hōs hē ammos tēs thalassēs to hypoleimma sōthēsetai
verses.literal: Isaiah cries out concerning Israel Though the number of the Israelites is like the sand of the sea only the remnant will be saved
verses.literalPt: Também Isaías clama acerca de Israel: Ainda que o número dos filhos de Israel seja como a areia do mar, o remanescente é que será salvo.

verses.original: λόγον γὰρ συντελῶν καὶ συντέμνων ποιήσει Κύριος ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς
verses.transliteration: logon gar syntelōn kai syntemnōn poiēsei Kyrios epi tēs gēs
verses.literal: For the Lord will carry out His sentence on the earth thoroughly and decisively
verses.literalPt: Porque ele completará a obra e abreviá-la-á em justiça; porque o Senhor fará breve a obra sobre a terra.

verses.original: Καὶ καθὼς προείρηκεν Ἠσαΐας Εἰ μὴ Κύριος Σαβαὼθ ἐγκατέλιπεν ἡμῖν σπέρμα ὡς Σόδομα ἂν ἐγενήθημεν καὶ ὡς Γόμορρα ἂν ὡμοιώθημεν
verses.transliteration: Kai kathōs proeirēken Ēsaias Ei mē Kyrios Sabaōth enkatelipen hēmin sperma hōs Sodoma an egenēthēmen kai hōs Gomorra an hōmoiōthēmen
verses.literal: It is just as Isaiah foretold Unless . . . the Lord of Hosts had left us descendants we would have become like Sodom we would have resembled . . . Gomorrah
verses.literalPt: E como antes disse Isaías: Se o Senhor dos Exércitos nos não deixara descendência, Teríamos nos tornado como Sodoma, e teríamos sido feitos como Gomorra.

verses.original: Τί οὖν ἐροῦμεν ὅτι ἔθνη τὰ μὴ διώκοντα δικαιοσύνην κατέλαβεν δικαιοσύνην δικαιοσύνην δὲ τὴν ἐκ πίστεως
verses.transliteration: Ti oun eroumen hoti ethnē ta mē diōkonta dikaiosynēn katelaben dikaiosynēn dikaiosynēn de tēn ek pisteōs
verses.literal: What then will we say That the Gentiles who did not pursue righteousness have obtained it a righteousness that is by faith
verses.literalPt: Que diremos pois? Que os gentios, que não buscavam a justiça, alcançaram a justiça? Sim, mas a justiça que é pela fé.

verses.original: Ἰσραὴλ δὲ διώκων νόμον δικαιοσύνης εἰς νόμον οὐκ ἔφθασεν
verses.transliteration: Israēl de diōkōn nomon dikaiosynēs eis nomon ouk ephthasen
verses.literal: but Israel who pursued a law of righteousness has not attained it
verses.literalPt: Mas Israel, que buscava a lei da justiça, não chegou à lei da justiça.

verses.original: διὰ τί ὅτι οὐκ ἐκ πίστεως ἀλλ’ ὡς ἐξ ἔργων προσέκοψαν τῷ λίθῳ τοῦ προσκόμματος
verses.transliteration: dia ti hoti ouk ek pisteōs all’ hōs ex ergōn prosekopsan tō lithō tou proskommatos
verses.literal: Why not . . . Because their pursuit was not by faith but as if it were by works They stumbled over the stumbling stone
verses.literalPt: Por quê? Porque não foi pela fé, mas como que pelas obras da lei; tropeçaram na pedra de tropeço;

verses.original: καθὼς γέγραπται Ἰδοὺ τίθημι ἐν Σιὼν λίθον προσκόμματος καὶ πέτραν σκανδάλου καὶ ὁ πιστεύων ἐπ’ αὐτῷ οὐ καταισχυνθήσεται
verses.transliteration: kathōs gegraptai Idou tithēmi en Siōn lithon proskommatos kai petran skandalou kai ho pisteuōn ep’ autō ou kataischynthēsetai
verses.literal: as it is written See I lay in Zion a stone of stumbling and a rock of offense and the one who believes in Him will never be put to shame
verses.literalPt: Como está escrito: Eis que eu ponho em Sião uma pedra de tropeço, e uma rocha de escândalo; E todo aquele que crer nela não será confundido.
